adapters.name: OCEAN

adapters.name: Sentinel BTCB2 Pool
adapters.notes: v0.2.81: Pool total stays canonical /api/v1/pool/btcb2 pool_hashrate_hs. Miner summary is normalized from miner-specific hashrate fields and the public pseudonymized /workers endpoint is merged when available. The observed miner can be ~100% of pool, so personal and pool rates may legitimately be nearly equal.
